stories.title: Export account data API
stories.acceptance_criteria: GET or POST endpoint returns JSON: venue, settings, users (no password hashes), time_entries for session venue. Admin-only, session venue_id matches slug.

stories.title: Export button and download
stories.acceptance_criteria: Venue settings page has 'Export account data' button; triggers download of tythe-export-{slug}-{date}.json.

stories.title: Delete account API
stories.acceptance_criteria: POST endpoint deletes venue and related data. Admin-only, session venue matches. Optional block for tythebarn. On success destroy session, return redirect info.

stories.title: Delete account button and confirmation
stories.acceptance_criteria: Venue settings has 'Delete account' with confirmation modal (e.g. type venue name). On confirm call API, then logout and redirect to /venues or login.

stories.title: Build and verification
stories.acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes. verify script passes. Export downloads file; delete confirms then clears session and redirects.
